title: Data Analyst

company_info.type: Iranian company dealing only with Iranian entities

job_description:
Didar is a cloud-based B2B CRM that helps businesses streamline sales processes and customer relationship management through data-driven solutions.
Job Description
We are currently looking for a Junior Data Analyst to help monitor business performance through data analysis, KPI tracking, and dashboard development. If you're passionate about working with data, providing meaningful insights, and enabling data-driven decision-making, we'd love to hear from you.
Responsibilities
Analyze and monitor KPIs across different teams.
Continuously analyze performance dashboards.
Train new employees on dashboard usage and prepare training documentation and processes.
Design dashboard templates.
Prepare reports from databases as needed.
Required Skills & Experience
Ability to analyze business and performance data (Sales, Marketing, Support, etc.).
Ability to analyze key performance indicators (KPIs).
Ability to create documentation and training processes for internal teams.
Basic familiarity with dashboarding tools (Excel, Power BI).
Familiarity with SQL.
Strong communication skills and the ability to present analytical reports to different teams.
